title: After Sale Service for Steel Buildings | Steel Mind
description: Repairs, extensions, repainting and added accessories for steel buildings. Steel Mind stays available after handover anywhere in Pakistan.
h1: After Sale Services in Pakistan: Repairs, Extensions and Support for Steel Buildings
quickAnswer: A steel building needs care for decades. Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. stays available after handover for repairs, repainting, added bays, new accessories and questions about the structure.
alt: Technicians inspecting an older steel shed roof during an after sale visit.

faq.q: Can Steel Mind repair a building another company built?
faq.a: Often yes, after an engineer inspects it.

faq.q: Can I add a bay later?
faq.a: Yes. Bolted PEB frames allow extra bays at the end of the building.

blocks.text: Businesses grow, and buildings must grow with them. Sheets get damaged, paint ages and new machines arrive. A contractor that built the structure knows its drawings and can make changes without guessing.

items.name: Repairs
items.text: Damaged sheets, trims, doors and connections.

items.name: Repainting
items.text: Cleaning and recoating of steel that has aged in the weather.

items.name: Extensions
items.text: Extra bays at the end of a PEB, or a new shed beside the first one.

items.name: Additions
items.text: Canopies, mezzanine floors, skylights, ventilators, doors and stairs.

items.name: Checks
items.text: A visit to look at the structure and advise on needed work.

blocks.title: Why Steel Mind Can Add to Its Own Buildings Easily

blocks.text: Steel Mind keeps the drawings and the 3D model of each project. Bolted PEB frames allow new bays to join the old ones. Dairy clients have returned to add feed storage and other structures, and Haier and Dravton Dairy have each had more than one structure built.

Call +92 300 4253966 or +92 307 7077549, or send a message from the Contact Us page. Share your project name, the site and a few photos. An engineer will reply with questions and the next step. Warranty terms are stated in each contract.
